answer: Re-attestations are stored in quill and dawn lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the basalt graph. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 15 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Verification costs 9 dollars and 1 days per identity, which turns a 1362 account sybil into a 8 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
